gravel_hill.ramp_note: Rendered as an earth ramp ~9 m wide, ~10 m long, centred on the barn west wall.

confirmed.barn: Same barn and place as today. Stone foundation ~8 ft. Upper floor via earth ramp centred on the west wall, two tractor-size sliding doors opening left and right. Ground floor on the south side: small door + large sliding door with a netless basketball hoop.
confirmed.driveway: All open gravel, graded for driving and parking. No grass inside it.
confirmed.grain_bin: Round wire-mesh corn crib with a cone cap.
confirmed.wood_burner: Barrel/box stove on short legs with a tall stovepipe.
confirmed.christmas_trees: Species bands west to east: Scotch pine, Douglas fir, white pine, blue spruce. Neat south-north lines. Sizes 15% knee high, 50% ~6 ft, 35% 8-10 ft.
confirmed.terrain: South of an E-W line through the north tip of the Christmas trees, land falls gradually to the pumpkin patch (lowest point). West of a line from the orchard west side to the farmhouse, land slopes down to the west.
